# Contributing

Follow the guidance in the central [MSX documentation](https://msx.no/docs/)
when contributing to this repo.

Write pull request descriptions using the canonical
[MSX PR Format](https://msx.no/docs/Ways-of-Working/PR-Format/) instructions.
Use its
[complete description example](https://msx.no/docs/Ways-of-Working/PR-Format/#complete-description-example)
for the actual PR record. Do not add or copy GitHub PR-template files; follow the
[Repository Standard's file policy](https://msx.no/docs/Ways-of-Working/Repository-Standard/#no-pr-template-files).
